methods.what: Cauchy–Riemann relation expressing du via the conjugate function v
Linear combination of three functions W, W', W'' chosen so that the periods across cuts K1, K2 vanish (two linear equations for α, β)
Argument principle bound for counting values (integral of d log(z−a))
Symmetric sums of the three branch values Z_i weighted by powers of derivatives z'_i
